src/building/building.repository.ts: Bui: onModuleInit runs it through ensureIndexesAtBoot, which warns and continues (ADR 0010 D2), so building.repository.spec.ts calls it directly to see which collection each campus-shape index lands on
src/building/catalog/building-catalog.re: the boot wrapper swallows a failed createIndex by design (ADR 0010 D2); building-catalog.repository.spec.ts calls it directly to pin the spaces and connections indexes
src/building/sync/building-sync.reposito: public only so building-sync.repository.spec.ts can pin the unique space key and the 2dsphere index, which onModuleInit would log and skip on failure (ADR 0010 D2)
src/map/map.repository.ts: MapRepository: map.repository.spec.ts drives it directly to pin the place and activation indexes, because ensureIndexesAtBoot in onModuleInit turns a rejection into a warning (ADR 0010 D2)
src/notices/dispatch/notices-dispatch.se: notices-dispatch.service.spec.ts pins one group's writes, its lease release when a write after the send fails, and its rejection paths by calling `dispatchGroup` directly, which a sweep reaches only through claims; that test is frozen through the stage 11 move (ADR 0011 D2)
src/scheduling/poller-registry.service.t: read only by specs: `poller-registry.service.spec.ts`, and `building-sync.poller.spec.ts`, which runs a real registry to see a failed sync declared; the other six poller specs pass a `registerPoller` spy, as ADR 0011 D2 prescribes, and the building deviation is tracked by spencer0124/skkuverse#67

called only by `poller-registry.service.spec.ts` and `building-sync.poller.spec.ts`, which start the registry directly because `onApplicationBootstrap` gates the start on ROLE; ADR 0011 D2 asks poller specs for a registry spy instead, a mismatch spencer0124/skkuverse#67 tracks

production reaches it only through onApplicationShutdown; `poller-registry.service.spec.ts` and the afterEach of `building-sync.poller.spec.ts` call it to clear real intervals, the one poller spec that departs from the ADR 0011 D2 registry spy (spencer0124/skkuverse#67)
